description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeeAllowedLanguageAPI that provides an API endpoint for retrieving the list of allowed languages for a specific employee in the OrangeHRM system. It handles GET requests to list languages, applies sorting and pagination, and interacts with the EmployeeLanguageService to fetch data.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLanguageAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for listing allowed languages for an employee, supporting sorting and pagination.
